The application under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act filed by the petitioners has been rejected on the ground that the petitioners have received compensation under the rehabilitation scheme.
It is contended, that this cannot be a ground for rejecting of application under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, which inpsite of the receipt of the compensation under the rehabilitation scheme has to be entertained (Page 48).
